title: Black-box model classification under the discriminative factorization
abstract: arXiv:2605.07878v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Access to modern generative systems is often restricted to querying an API (the ``black-box'' setting) and many properties of the system are unknown to the user at inference time. Recent work has shown that low-dimensional representations of models based on the relationship of their embedded responses to a set of queries are useful for inferring model-level properties. However, the quality of these representations is highly sensitive to the query set. We introduce the \emph{discriminative factorization} to distinguish between high- and low-quality query sets in the context of black-box model-level classification. Under this framework, the probability of chance-level classification is bounded by a term that decays exponentially in the query budget. translated_title: 判别式因子分解下的黑盒模型分类
translated_abstract: 对现代生成式系统的访问通常仅限于通过API进行查询（即“黑盒”设置），并且在推理时用户对该系统的许多属性一无所知。最近的研究表明，基于模型对一组查询的嵌入响应之间关系所构建的模型低维表示，对于推断模型层面的属性非常有用。然而，这些表示的质量对查询集高度敏感。我们引入了“判别式因子分解”，用于在黑盒模型级分类的情境下区分高质量和低质量的查询集。在该框架下，随机水平分类的概率被一个随查询预算呈指数衰减的项所界定。在三个审计任务中，估计出的因子分解参数能够预测经验性能的衰减率。最后，我们展示了使用估计的因子分解（参数）所选出的查询集……
tldr: 提出判别式因子分解框架，用于区分黑盒模型级分类中查询集的质量优劣，理论上证明随机分类概率随查询预算呈指数衰减，并实证表明据此估计参数可预测性能衰减率并指导选取高质量查询集。
en_tdlr: Introduces discriminative factorization to distinguish high- from low-quality query sets in black-box model-level classification, bounding chance-level classification probability by a term that decays exponentially with the query budget.
